cc:Work.dc:description: Attributed redraw of the subjective QOA codec landscape and Triangle of Neglect, with individual Opus, Vorbis, MP3, WavPack, FLAC, QOA, ADPCM and WAV points. RGS extends from approximately 216 to 285 kb/s and is placed above QOA for its additional format and decoder rules. Vertical distances are illustrative, not decode timings; encoder search effort is not plotted. Quality labels are subjective; RGS is rated good as the project's own assessment.
